options.name: binary
options.description: Specifies if the file being fetched is a binary.

options.name: dest
options.description: Local path where the file or data set will be stored. If dest is an existing file or directory, the contents will be overwritten.

options.name: encoding
options.description: Specifies which encodings the fetched data set should be converted from and to. If this parameter is not provided, encoding conversions will not take place.

options.name: fail_on_missing
options.description: When set to true, the task will fail if the source file is missing.

options.name: flat
options.description: If set to "true", override the default behavior of appending hostname/path/to/file to the destination, instead the file or data set will be fetched to the destination directory without appending remote hostname to the destination.

options.name: ignore_sftp_stderr
options.description: During data transfer through SFTP, the SFTP command directs content to stderr. By default, the module essentially ignores the stderr stream produced by SFTP and continues execution. The user is able to override this behavior by setting this parameter to C(false). By doing so, any content written to stderr is considered an error by Ansible and will cause the module to fail. When Ansible verbosity is set to greater than 3, either through the command line interface (CLI) using B(-vvvv) or through e

options.name: src
options.description: Name of a UNIX System Services (USS) file, PS (sequential data set), PDS, PDSE, member of a PDS, PDSE, GDS, GDG or KSDS (VSAM data set). USS file paths should be absolute paths.

options.name: tmp_hlq
options.description: Override the default high level qualifier (HLQ) for temporary and backup datasets. The default HLQ is the Ansible user used to execute the module and if that is not available, then the value C(TMPHLQ) is used.

options.name: use_qualifier
options.description: Indicates whether the data set high level qualifier should be used when fetching.

options.name: validate_checksum
options.description: Verify that the source and destination checksums match after the files are fetched.
